main.description: A political committee registered with the FEC (PAC, super PAC, party or campaign committee) that gave to or spent on current members of Congress, or a group or person that isn't a political committee but reported outside spending on them (FEC Form 5 or 9). The record key is the FEC id (e.g. 'C00030718').

id.description: FEC committee id; also the record key.

connectedOrg.description: Connected organization as filed with the FEC.

orgType.description: FEC organization type: C corporation, L labor, M membership, T trade, V cooperative, W corporation without stock.

kind.description: 'non-committee': a group or person that isn't a political committee and reports independent expenditures (Form 5) or electioneering communications (Form 9).

reportedDonations.description: Non-committee filers with reports on file: US dollars their Form 5 or Form 9 reports list as received to pay for this spending, over the dataset's cycles. 0 means the filings name no donors.

person.description: Form 5 filers who report as an individual rather than a group.

sponsors.description: Leadership PACs: the members of Congress who run them.

total.description: US dollars given to current members.

opponents.description: Independent expenditures on current members' opponents; targets are the members whose races it was (bioguide ids).

donors.description: Donors of $50,000 or more (fyi.contributions.donor record keys), largest first.

uri.description: The sponsor's fyi.contributions.member record, if they're a current member.

electioneering.description: Electioneering communications naming current members: ads that don't say vote for or against.
